summary: United Nova Technology's fourth-phase project in Shaoxing, a single 300 mm line for automotive-grade mixed-signal chips planned at about CNY 20 billion and 50,000 wafers a month, run through a joint venture in which the company keeps 25.1%. It covers 40/28nm MCU and DSP, 90/55nm BCD and other analog processes, and 55nm silicon photonics. The framework agreement was signed in June 2026 and the investors had completed their capital subscriptions by September 2026; no construction start has been reported.

metrics.note: Planned as CNY 12 billion of registered capital and CNY 8 billion of bank loans.

milestones.note: Joint-venture framework agreement signed; the parent said on 21 September 2026 that all capital subscriptions were complete.
